chunks: A general proclamation is (made) this day of the Greater Pilgrimage on the part of God and His Apostle, that God is not bound (by any contract) to idolaters, nor is His Apostle. It is, therefore, better for you to repent. If you do not, remember that you cannot elude (the grip of) God. So announce to those who deny the truth the news of painful punishment,

key_terms.يَوْمَ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ: The Day of the Greater Pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the proclamation made on the Day of the Greater Pilgrimage regarding polytheists?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet's declaration at Mina, establishing a definitive break with polytheistic treaties and emphasizing divine justice. It serves as a pivotal moment where the call to Islam becomes universal, highlighting the consequences of steadfastness in faith versus persistent disbelief.
